verdict.rationale: Asking whether a tax authority publishes filing deadlines and penalty/interest schedules is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack covers tax filing due dates, failure-to-file or failure-to-pay penalty rates, or interest rates. The exact figures it does contain (EIN assistant operating hours, the 45-day e-file provider approval window, the 1-EIN-per-day limit) are operational limits, not filing deadlines or penalty schedules, so they do not transfer to this story.
